bids.title: Job Order Contracting Services
bids.description: A Job Order Contract is an indefinite quantity construction contract pursuant to which the Contractor may perform an ongoing series of individual Projects at different locations and facilities under the jurisdiction of the City. Job Order Contracting is typically used for small to medium sized repair and rehabilitation work, replacement in kind projects, and new construction. The Work will be set forth in the Detailed Scope of Work for individual Job Orders. The City expects the Contractor to perform the Detailed Scope of Work for each Job Order, which may include, without limitation, the renovation or repair of buildings, utilities, parks, and playgrounds. The Contractor is required to complete each Detailed Scope of Work for the Job Order Price within the Job Order Completion Time. The Contractor will be required to perform Work at any site or facility under the jurisdiction of the City.

bids.title: 3289L South Boulevard 2745 Zone Reservoir Inlet/Outlet Pipeline
bids.description: Las Vegas Valley Water District invites qualified firms (Bidders) to submit Bids for the following Work, see Contract Documents for full details. The Site of the Work is located southwest of Las Vegas Boulevard within the Clark County and City of Henderson jurisdictions. The point of connection for the pipeline is located approximately 850 feet east of the intersection of W Welpman Way and Las Vegas Boulevard. The alignment will go through existing BLM Grants, Private Easements, and Patent Easements to the South Boulevard 2745 Zone Reservoir site (3288L), which is located on A.P.N. 191-30-501-005. Additionally, the project will include Work at the 2860 Zone South Pumping Station and Forebay which is located on Highland Crown Rd on the west side of the Southern Highlands residential community (A.P.N. 191-07-101-002). The project consists of installing approximately 18,000 linear feet of 42-inch-diameter mortar-lined, tape-wrapped, and mortar-coated steel pipe, including communications infrastructure consisting of fiber optic conduit, pull boxes, and necessary appurtenances along the length of the pipeline. The project will also include construction/installation of four 42-inch butterfly valves, with associated cast-in-place concrete vaults, a sacrificial anode cathodic protection system, and other water pipeline appurtenances. Additionally, the project will remove an existing 12-inch gate valve and replace it with a 12-inch butterfly valve located within an existing vault at the 2860 Zone South Pumping Station and Forebay. The project will also include electrical/communications improvements for the new valves. Engineer’s Estimate is: $ 28,203,225.00
